source.text: Ayer yo camino al parque. El arbol es bonito. La casa son grande. Quiero tomar un café.

annotations.notice: Look at the time word ayer.
annotations.question: Is this happening now or yesterday?
annotations.hint: Yesterday is a finished past time.
annotations.explanation: For this completed walk yesterday, use the preterite.
annotations.retry_focus: Write another short sentence about yesterday.

annotations.question: Which syllable is stressed?
annotations.hint: Say the word aloud: which part sounds strongest?
annotations.explanation: Árbol is stressed on the next-to-last syllable and ends in l, so it needs a written accent: ÁR-bol.
annotations.retry_focus: Try writing árbol in your own sentence.

annotations.notice: Notice the subject and verb together.
annotations.question: Is casa singular or plural?
annotations.hint: One house needs a singular verb.
annotations.explanation: La casa is singular, so es agrees with it.

annotations.notice: Here is an optional softer way to say this.
annotations.question: Would you like a softer tone?
annotations.hint: Gustaría can express a polite wish.
annotations.explanation: Your wording works. This alternative is a more indirect way to express the wish.

items.reason: Optional softer expression for the same wish.

annotations.retry_focus: Try either expression in a short café request.
